```{=html}
<script>
window.addEventListener("load", () => {
  const slideId = "gpu-aware-mpi-with-p2prdma";
  let startTimer;
  const startAnimation = svg => {
    const staticMarker = svg.querySelector(".data-static");
    const movingMarker = svg.querySelector(".data-moving");
    window.clearTimeout(startTimer);
    svg.setCurrentTime(0);
    svg.pauseAnimations();
    staticMarker.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
    movingMarker.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
    startTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      staticMarker.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
      movingMarker.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
      svg.unpauseAnimations();
      movingMarker.querySelector("animateMotion").beginElement();
    }, 500);
  };
  Reveal.on("slidechanged", event => {
    const previousSvg = event.previousSlide?.querySelector(".gpu-aware-p2p-animation");
    if (previousSvg) {
      window.clearTimeout(startTimer);
      previousSvg.pauseAnimations();
      previousSvg.setCurrentTime(0);
      previousSvg.querySelector(".data-static").setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
      previousSvg.querySelector(".data-moving").setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
    }
    if (event.currentSlide.id !== slideId) return;
    const svg = event.currentSlide.querySelector(".gpu-aware-p2p-animation");
    svg.pauseAnimations();
    svg.setCurrentTime(0);
    if (svg.querySelector(".animation-trigger").classList.contains("visible")) startAnimation(svg);
  });
  Reveal.on("fragmentshown", event => {
    if (!event.fragment.matches(".gpu-aware-p2p-animation .animation-trigger")) return;
    startAnimation(event.fragment.closest(".gpu-aware-p2p-animation"));
  });
});
</script>
```
